title: UL-05 — Challenge: VPC segmentation
scenario: Extend GL-05 to dual-AZ layout with tighter NACL rules on private subnets. Still no NAT.
acceptanceCriteria: VPC spans two Availability Zones with at least one public and one private subnet per AZ (four subnets total).
Private subnets in both AZs share one route table with no 0.0.0.0/0 to an IGW or NAT.
Network ACL on private subnets denies inbound SSH (tcp/22) explicitly.
Public subnets route 0.0.0.0/0 to an internet gateway.
S3 gateway endpoint is attached to private route tables.
No NAT gateway exists in the VPC.
Security groups follow least privilege (no 0.0.0.0/0 on admin ports).
All resources tagged LabId=ul-05 where supported.
You can draw which AZ each subnet belongs to.
Teardown deletes subnets then IGW then VPC.
No elastic network interfaces remain in VPC.
describe-nat-gateways for the VPC is empty after work.
Same-hour estimate documented as near-zero without NAT.

hints.text: Use /24 per subnet; watch AZ names.

solution.outline: Dual-AZ VPC without NAT; teardown verified.

stopChargesPanel: Remove endpoints, IGW, subnets, ACLs, SGs, VPC for ul-05 tags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-05 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-05 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-05 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-05. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-05) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
